<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|“Long before my time as Patriarch, Orthos served as a liaison between the Arelius and the imperial Blackflame family.}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|— ''Blackflame'', chapter 10}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Orthos Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Orthos is a massive black turtle and a descendant of the [[Blackflame Empire]]'s royal [[Black dragons|black dragons]]. A long-standing and loyal ally to the [[Arelius family]], he previously acted as a mediator between them and the imperial [[Blackflame]] lineage. Physically, he is characterized by a heavy, wide body and a shell featuring glowing red facets that emit hazy black smoke. His power is often manifested through dark flames, abyssal fire, and a red-and-black corona. Orthos is known for his immense size, which can fluctuate significantly; he has been seen as a creature large enough to crush towns or reach sizes comparable to a mid-sized [[Dreadgod]], though his growth is dependent on [[soulfire]]. Beyond his turtle form, Orthos can take a human shape appearing as a man with leathery black skin and gray hair. In combat, he is described as a destructive force rather than a defensive one, utilizing heavy physical strikes and powerful [[madra]]. Despite his formidable strength and prideful nature, he has faced significant injuries and periods of weakness, including a time when his core was unsteady. He possesses deep knowledge regarding [[dragons]] and has spent much of his life protecting the city of [[Serpent's Grave]]. Throughout his history, he has maintained a complex relationship with various figures, serving as both a protector and a fierce, sometimes jealous, combatant.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Orthos is a massive, Black dragons{{!}}black dragon-turtle with leathery skin and a shell that smolders with red light and smoke. His eyes are dark orbs containing rings of red, and he can shift into a human form characterized by wrinkled black skin and gray hair. In his turtle state, he can also expand his size using [[soulfire]] to become as large as a hill.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A [[sacred beast]] and elder [[dragon]], Orthos is a companion to [[Lindon]] who possesses a core of rolling rage and eagerness. He can radiate concern, speak gravely, or grumble when inconvenienced, and he has been known to teach [[dragons]] not to whine. He is a protective figure who provides encouragement and training to his allies.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Orthos is a contracted partner and companion to [[Lindon]], serving as his teacher and providing him with power. He is an ally to [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]], [[Mercy]], [[Yerin]], [[Carmine]], and [[Little Blue]], having fought alongside them. He has also interacted with [[Eithan]], [[Dross]], and [[Naru Cassias Arelius|Cassias]], while being observed by [[Akura Malice]] and mentioned by [[Akura Pride|Pride]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Orthos utilizes [[Blackflame madra]], [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]] that can include touches of the Void and [[dragons|Dragon]] [[Icons]], and a [[Burning Cloak]]. His combat techniques include using an [[Enforced]] paw to crack the ground, whipping his tail, and calling down tornadoes of black fire. Additionally, he can use a ruler [[technique]], absorb [[constructs]], and transfer his power to others.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Liaison of the Blackflame}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Orthos is a sacred [[dragon]]-turtle who serves as a liaison between the [[Arelius family|Arelius]] and the imperial [[Blackflame family]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c10">''Blackflame'', chapter 10</ref> Nearly three hundred years old, the creature suffers from a buildup of [[Blackflame madra]] in his system that makes his [[spirit]] feel like a boulder stopping up a volcano.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c10" /> Though he has been helped by [[elixirs]] made from [[Riverseed]] power, his strength is comparable to that of a [[Truegold]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c10" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c11">''Blackflame'', chapter 11</ref> He was tasked with delivering a package to [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c11" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Companion in Skysworn}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Orthos is a character who follows [[Fisher Gesha]] and consumes tapestry, though the creature could potentially be used to ease a fight.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c10" /> A [[sacred beast]] that [[Lindon]] has fought many times, Orthos is currently held under restraints.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c12">''Skysworn'', chapter 12</ref> This black, leathery turtle feeds on fear and has previously burned a hole in a wall.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c13">''Skysworn'', chapter 13</ref> During the course, [[Lindon]] rides Orthos, a contracted beast that identifies as a [[dragon]] and possesses power on the level of a [[Truegold]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c15">''Skysworn'', chapter 15</ref> While [[cycling]] [[Blackflame]], the creature utilizes its shell and ability to breathe fire.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c15" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c16">''Skysworn'', chapter 16</ref> The turtle's core feels like rolling rage, and as [[Lindon]]'s contracted beast, it is a creature that can crash through webs and snarl.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c16" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c17">''Skysworn'', chapter 17</ref> Although Orthos cannot speak, it can extend its neck from its shell and was seen eating fragments of pottery.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c17" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c18">''Skysworn'', chapter 18</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Journey through Ghostwater}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Orthos is a turtle characterized by black eyes that contain rings of red.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c2">''Ghostwater'', chapter 2</ref> This creature possesses a deep red, cracked shell that is nearly as wide as he is tall and reaches the height of a horse's back.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c3">''Ghostwater'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c5">''Ghostwater'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c9">''Ghostwater'', chapter 9</ref> Capable of launching [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]] and releasing flares of [[Blackflame madra]], Orthos can growl with enough force to shake the sand.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c3" /> Following a battle that left his [[spirit]] throbbing with deep pain, Orthos became weak and unconscious with a damaged soul.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6">''Ghostwater'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c9" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c12">''Ghostwater'', chapter 12</ref> Despite his condition, his eyes smolder with orange-red light as he instructs [[Lindon]] on how to convert [[aura]] into [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c8">''Ghostwater'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c9" /> Orthos has trained [[Lindon]] by teaching him about the [[Path of Black Flame]] and providing words to bolster him.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c10">''Ghostwater'', chapter 10</ref> A capable swimmer that uses his feet like flippers, Orthos eventually steps into the [[water]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c11">''Ghostwater'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c12" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Spirit Well recovery}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Orthos is a turtle whose [[spirit]] is currently improving due to the [[Spirit Well]] and has undergone a cleansing process.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c13">''Ghostwater'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15">''Ghostwater'', chapter 15</ref> Located near [[Lindon]], the creature is able to communicate with him through a direct spiritual connection.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c13" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c16">''Ghostwater'', chapter 16</ref> As a creature possessing the power of a [[Truegold]], Orthos provides power to [[Lindon]] after hitting the ground shell-first.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c16" /> The turtle is only one step away from breaking through to [[Underlord]], though its [[Burning Cloak]] is dying.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c18">''Ghostwater'', chapter 18</ref> This creature can whip its tail or retreat inside its shell to command others.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c18" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c19">''Ghostwater'', chapter 19</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|While positioned on the deck alongside [[Lindon]] and [[Mercy]], Orthos carries [[Little Blue]] upon the top of his head.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c2">''Underlord'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c3">''Underlord'', chapter 3</ref> During the [[Truegold]] advance, he roared and utilized black-and-red [[dragon]] breath that can bite off techniques.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c3" /> This creature can blow smoke and smolders with [[Blackflame]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c4">''Underlord'', chapter 4</ref> He noted that [[Skysworn armor]] leaves the head unprotected before stomping on a fleeing man.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5">''Underlord'', chapter 5</ref> Residing within [[Lindon]]'s soul, Orthos is a broad, black turtle that appears as a smoldering red presence.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c7">''Underlord'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8">''Underlord'', chapter 8</ref> He does not have [[Thousand-Mile Cloud|Thousand-Mile Clouds]] stored in his [[emerald armor]] and rumbled in response to [[Eithan]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8" /> Orthos is a person [[Lindon]] fears losing, yet he left one month ago for a period of a few years.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c9">''Underlord'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c15">''Underlord'', chapter 15</ref> Because of his departure, [[Lindon]] became worked up, and Orthos is now gone.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c9" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c22">''Underlord'', chapter 22</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Descendant of black dragons}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Orthos is a sacred turtle and a descendant of the [[Blackflame Empire]]'s [[Black dragons|black dragons]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c1">''Uncrowned'', chapter 1</ref> Although he was a [[Truegold]] before the birth of [[Kelsa]]'s grandparents, his power has leaked away since his arrival and he is currently no higher than a [[Jade]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c1" /> His eyes are comparable to those of the [[Black dragons|black dragons]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c14">''Uncrowned'', chapter 14</ref> Following treatment from [[Little Blue]] and [[Lindon]]'s [[pure madra]], Orthos was briefly returned to himself.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c16">''Uncrowned'', chapter 16</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Orthos is a creature capable of shoving wooden beams using only one foreleg.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28">''Wintersteel'', chapter 28</ref> This character harbors a hatred for waiting without cause.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Located in the western [[Blackflame Empire]], Orthos is a turtle who exists as an indistinct lump within the back of [[Lindon]]'s mind.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c5">''Bloodline'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c6">''Bloodline'', chapter 6</ref> Having spent time in [[Sacred Valley]], the turtle shared stories regarding [[Lindon]] and [[sacred artists]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c7">''Bloodline'', chapter 7</ref> [[Lindon]] mentions Orthos while the creature is sitting with [[Mercy]] and [[Yerin]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c8">''Bloodline'', chapter 8</ref> This turtle can produce sounds resembling an earthquake and is capable of stretching his head to reach a table.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c9">''Bloodline'', chapter 9</ref> Affected by the [[earth aura]], Orthos is also capable of radiating concern.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c9" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Associated with the exiles at the [[Fallen Leaf School]], Orthos is located at that same site.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c9" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c12">''Bloodline'', chapter 12</ref> After observing the existence of two [[Dreadgods]], Orthos led [[Lindon]]'s family into the [[fortress]] and informed [[Lindon]] that he had saved lives.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c13">''Bloodline'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c15">''Bloodline'', chapter 15</ref> This shell-bearing creature, which is an outsider to [[Lindon]]'s home, consumes firewood and wooden chests while emitting smoke.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c16">''Bloodline'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18">''Bloodline'', chapter 18</ref> Orthos' presence within [[Lindon]]'s [[spirit]] became brighter and more powerful than ever as he used treasures from the [[void key]] to advance.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c19">''Bloodline'', chapter 19</ref> As a turtle that expands his size by filling his body with [[soulfire]], Orthos is currently a struggling creature held by the [[Titan]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c20">''Bloodline'', chapter 20</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Companion to Lindon}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Orthos is a currently weak [[spirit]] that appears as a flaming turtle the size of a hill.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c5">''Reaper'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c6">''Reaper'', chapter 6</ref> After undergoing a transformation, the creature became a tiny red-and-black turtle that accompanies [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c6" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c7">''Reaper'', chapter 7</ref> While resting on [[Lindon]]'s shoulder, Orthos questioned [[Eithan]]'s plan and was observed hopping about while eating hammers.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c10">''Reaper'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c11">''Reaper'', chapter 11</ref> The creature, which possesses black pebbly skin and the ability to breathe flame, can also emit a red-and-black glare and use [[soulfire]] to blow away [[dream aura]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c12">''Reaper'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c14">''Reaper'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c21">''Reaper'', chapter 21</ref> Orthos has demonstrated the ability to burn [[blood]] away and transfer power to [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c14" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c20">''Reaper'', chapter 20</ref> After eating [[Lindon]]'s plants and pots and glaring at him, the [[spirit]] eventually approached the [[Nethergate]] before [[Lindon]] was forced to leave him behind.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c19">''Reaper'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c21" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c23">''Reaper'', chapter 23</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Orthos is a turtle from [[Serpent's Grave|Serpent’s Grave]] who serves as a companion to [[Lindon]] and [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5">''Dreadgod'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7">''Dreadgod'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c13">''Dreadgod'', chapter 13</ref> Because of his proximity to [[Lindon]], he is not [[safe]] from the [[Dreadgod]], and he remains one of six beings threatened by the [[Silent King]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3">''Dreadgod'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4">''Dreadgod'', chapter 4</ref> This creature possesses the ability to absorb [[constructs]] and can even ignite the [[Burning Cloak]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c13" /> Believing he can handle himself, Orthos seeks to claim his [[inheritance]] by finding the tomb of his ancestors.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7" /> He is associated with an ancient castle and was buried under [[Shatterspine Castle]] alongside [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18">''Dreadgod'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19">''Dreadgod'', chapter 19</ref> Orthos possesses a collection of [[Remnants]] consisting of one [[Archlord]] [[Black dragons|black dragon]], two Overlords, six [[Underlord|Underlords]], fifteen [[Golds]], and one [[Herald]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21">''Dreadgod'', chapter 21</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Orthos, a four-footed turtle capable of snorting smoke, entered the [[pocket world]] through a doorway while accompanying [[Lindon]] and [[Little Blue]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2">''Waybound'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c3">''Waybound'', chapter 3</ref> Carrying a [[void key]] for [[Little Blue]], the creature collapsed during a test after reeling from the impact of foreign [[willpower]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c3" /> As a turtle who provides encouragement during training, Orthos fought alongside [[Little Blue]] against a single opponent using his shell and lances of [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c3" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10">''Waybound'', chapter 10</ref> While training in [[Ghostwind Hall]], Orthos reached the peak of Overlord and received advice from [[Yerin]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c12">''Waybound'', chapter 12</ref> Orthos and [[Little Blue]] were sealed away to train together, during which time Orthos wrestled against the mind and [[spirit]] of another to avoid losing himself.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c13">''Waybound'', chapter 13</ref> Now an [[Archlord]] and a newborn [[Herald]], the human with wrinkled black skin and gray hair can spit a burst of [[fire madra]], though he felt embarrassed to tie with [[Little Blue]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c17">''Waybound'', chapter 17</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Battle with Weeping Dragon}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|During the clash against the [[Weeping Dragon]], Orthos fought alongside [[Lindon]] and [[Little Blue]], though both companions were too weak to face the creature alone.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19">''Waybound'', chapter 19</ref> Orthos crushed [[Striker techniques]] in his hands and struck the [[dragon]] with a massive breath that contained traces of [[dragons|Dragon]] [[Icons]] and the Void.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /> As a being bound to the [[Dreadgods]], Orthos experienced a mental sensation that made the world appear to slow down.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20">''Waybound'', chapter 20</ref> He unleashed techniques to block the [[Weeping Dragon]] while [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] worked to prevent the [[dragon]]'s movement or storm from killing Orthos, [[Little Blue]], [[Mercy]], or [[Yerin]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" /> After [[Akura Malice]]'s shadows crept toward him, Orthos used [[soulfire]] along with life and [[Blood aura|blood aura]] to sustain [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]]'s body.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21">''Waybound'', chapter 21</ref> Once [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] was healed, Orthos stepped away in relief, though he faced difficulties establishing [[Authority|authority]] over the [[Weeping Dragon]]'s [[binding]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">13</span></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Human form}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|In his human form, Orthos observed [[Mercy]]'s preparations with a flat expression and noted that no one had inquired about [[Dross]]'s concerns.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23">''Waybound'', chapter 23</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26">''Waybound'', chapter 26</ref> During the conflict, he spoke in a grave manner while using [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]] to blast a [[construct]] apart.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27">''Waybound'', chapter 27</ref> Possessing black-and-red eyes and [[Blackflame claws]], he drew power from [[Lindon]]'s cores.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c28">''Waybound'', chapter 28</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30">''Waybound'', chapter 30</ref> Flanking [[Lindon]], Orthos rumbled while chewing on gravel and snorting smoke from his nose.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c36">''Waybound'', chapter 36</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Dreadgod}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Orthos is a [[Dreadgod]] and an elder [[dragon]] whom [[Akura Pride|Pride]] was advised not to listen to.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c10" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 11</ref> This barrier island [[dragon]]-turtle travels with [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] and [[Carmine]], though the creature can also reside in a shell on [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]]'s shoulder.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" /> Capable of blowing jets of fire and calling down tornadoes of black fire, Orthos can land in a pulse of black-and-red fire and possesses eyes of the same colors while smoldering like a live coal.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" /> While able to stay in a larger size to hear people inside buildings, Orthos can also shift into the human form of a gray-haired man with black skin.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref> During a mission accompanying [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]], Orthos brought a clutch of [[dragon]] eggs, blew out a mouthful of smoke, and suggested that the world be named [[Windfall]] after their former ship.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Orthos]] smolders like a live coal and has black-and-red eyes.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Orthos]] can stay in a larger size and hear people inside buildings.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Orthos]] is an elder [[dragon]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Orthos]] can call down a tornado of black fire.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Orthos]] teaches [[dragons]] that they shouldn't whine.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Orthos]] accompanied [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] on a mission.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Orthos]] can shift into a human form of a black-skinned, gray-haired man.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Orthos]] blew out a mouthful of smoke.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Orthos]] brought a clutch of [[dragon]] eggs.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Orthos]] told [[Dross]] not to make up words.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Orthos]] suggested naming the world [[Windfall]] after their former ship.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|“Long before my time as Patriarch, Orthos served as a liaison between the Arelius and the imperial Blackflame family.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c10" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|The sacred beast snorted, pulling back. “Cycle Blackflame and say that to me again.”<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|“A good fight is a short fight,” Orthos said.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c4" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|"He's your contracted beast, isn't he?" Mercy asked.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c16" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Now it was time to execute Orthos' plan, which—in its entirety—consisted of one step: “Hit it with your arm.”<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c8" />}}
